newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Wednesday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Wednesday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Wednesday:
Spokesman Joao Vale de Almeida said there would be a technical briefing on the directive on control of volatile organic compounds (VOCs) in the office of spokesman Peter Jorgensen at 1500/1400 GMT.
Vale de Almeida said the Commission had taken note that the Danish Member of the Standing Veterinary Committee Susan Ammendrup had denied having received political pressure from the Commission.
He also said that the Commission denied disagreements between Commissioners Fischler and Brittan on the evolution of the Common Agricultural Policy (CAP).

In answer to a question, Vale de Almeida said humanitarian assistance in the Great Lakes area would need secure conditions to be efficient and that practical means to reach those conditions would be discussed on Thursday.

He also said that conclusions from the Nairobi summit on the Great Lakes area crisis had confirmed the Commission's policy for humanitarian assistance in the medium term and its involvement in the area.

Asked about links between EU-China trade cooperation and the human rights situation in China, spokesman Peter Guilford said several Commission projects in the country would help improve human rights directly or indirectly.

Spokesman Josep Coll i Carbo said Commissioner Manuel Marin would not go to East Jerusalem during his visit to the Middle East. He also said Commissioner Marin would meet EU special envoy to the Middle East Miguel Angel Moratinos in the afternoon.
Vale de Almeida said Commission President Santer had sent a congratulatory telegram to President Bill Clinton.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/96/982: East Zaire: Commission proposes regional stability pact and analyses humanitarian intervention.
- IP/96/984: Application of conditionality in the cohesion fund.
- IP/96/985: Commission proposes directive on control of VOCs from the solvent industry./
- IP/96/986: Aids for the Italian agriterminal sector.
- IP/96/987: Measures in favour of the Italian sugar sector.
- IP/96/989: Economic convergence in the Union in 1996.
- IP/96/990: SLIM: new method to simplify single market legislation.
- IP/96/991: Commission authorizes German aid schemes for ship operating companies.
- IP/96/992: Bremer Vulkan: Commission conducts initial interim review and widens current investigation - diverted resources DM 200 million higher than suspected.
- IP/96/993: Sound and efficient financial management.
- COM/96/560: Report on convergence in the European Union in 1996.
- Oil Bulletin No 843.
- ME/96 6.11: Midday express.
